## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `bash .github/scripts/privacy-guard.sh` passes
- [ ] New code has tests (fixtures, no network)
- [ ] `docs/CONTRACTS.md` updated if a command, flag or file format changed
- [ ] README / docs/SETUP.md updated if user-facing behaviour changed
- [ ] No personal data: no real resumes, profile files, tracker data or personal company lists; fixtures trimmed and anonymised
- [ ] No new dependencies (or the reason is explained above)
- [ ] `.claude/settings.json` still allows only specific `gaj` subcommands and npm scripts; `gaj fetch` stays unapproved
- [ ] Prompts and docs follow the writing rules in CONTRIBUTING.md
